figures.caption: Figure 1. Overview of LROT. (A) Section coordinates, expression matrices and a species-specific LR resource. (B) Non-LR expression, directed LR compatibility and within-section geometry costs. (C) Cost fusion, outer GW updates and inner Sinkhorn scaling. (D) Row entropy describes the dispersion of the soft transport plan over candidate target spots; the annotation-derived layer-vote score requires target-layer labels and does not constitute probability calibration. The H&E thumbnail, conceptual curves and serial-section stack are schematic illustrations: histology is not an input to the tested LROT implementation, and the reconstruction experiments use five simulated sections or three measured DLPFC sections.

figures.caption: Figure 3. Descriptive comparisons and primary repeated evidence. (A) Realistic seed-42 region-label agreement.
